Strong_Crushing_Mandibles.description: The Strong_Crushing_Mandibles, gleaming with chitinous armor and beetle-like resilience, crackle with the promise of crushing strength as they snap shut, emitting a sharp click-hiss that stuns foes and crushes prey beneath their formidable jaws.

Piercing_Drain_Proboscis.description: The Piercing Drain Proboscis, a fearsome appendage of an insectile parasite with mosquito-like features, is adorned with barbed tendrils that pierce flesh to leach nourishment and emit a hypnotic buzz.
